instruction: Candid documentary photograph of a couple on a rocky shoreline under an overcast sky. The woman in the striped sweater (R2) stands in the foreground, smiling and looking slightly to the left. The bearded man in the blue vest (R1) stands directly behind her, wearing glasses and looking down at her with a gentle smile. He wraps his arms around her from behind, and she crosses her arms over his. The cool, natural daylight illuminates the scene, with the blue sea and grey sky creating a serene, windy atmosphere.
elements: R1 stands directly behind R2 and wraps his arms around her from behind
R2 crosses her arms over R1's arms
R1 is the rear partner encircling R2 while R2 is the foreground partner
R1 looks down at R2 with a gentle smile
the couple is on a rocky shoreline under an overcast sky
